question: Which of the following reactions of drug metabolism has an oxidation reaction as an intermediate step ?:

options.opa: The transformation of a nitro group (for example, the one existing in nitrofurantoin) into amino.
options.opb: The O-demethylation of an ether (for example, the transformation of codeine into morphine).
options.opc: The breaking down of a diazo group to originate an amine (for example, the transformation of Prontosilrubrum into sulfanilamide.
options.opd: The transformation of oxazepam in its glucuronide.
options.ope: The transformation of acetylcholine into choline.
